sources.title: Flux (text-to-image model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Flux is a family of text-to-image and image-to-image models developed by Black Forest Labs (BFL), based in Freiburg im Breisgau, Germany. Black Forest Labs was founded by former employees of Stability AI. As with other text-to-image models, Flux generates images from natural language descriptions, called prompts. In addition, some Flux models support editing images.
